name: mindbox
description: Build marketing scenarios, audience filters and emails in a Mindbox project from plain-language requests: flow-create designs and fills a scenario, filter-build builds a platform-confirmed filter, filter-explain reads one back in business terms, email writes an email layout and email-ops previews it, saves it into a campaign and edits the campaign. Nothing is launched or sent to customers, and no filter is saved as a segment.

interface.shortDescription: Build marketing scenarios, audience filters and emails in a Mindbox project
interface.longDescription: Describe a campaign in plain language and the skills do the platform work: design and fill a scenario, build an audience filter the platform confirms, read an existing filter back in business terms, write an email layout, preview it and save it into a campaign. Needs an MCP connection to the Mindbox project you work in. Nothing is launched and nothing is sent to customers.
defaultPrompt: Build a welcome scenario for customers who subscribed this week
Explain what audience this filter actually selects
Write a promo email and save it into a campaign
